routing_rules_applied: Do not label FALSE merely because evidence is absent.
Proposed civic mechanisms are not treated as implemented systems.

routes.rationale: Title/version strings are present in the frozen Source A bytes; file SHA-256 already matches the expected digest.

The author-stated checksum string is textually present. Interpretation as cryptographic integrity is not supported by the string itself; that misinterpretation is ruled out now without calling the author text FALSE.
No measurement protocol, instrument data, or independent frequency evidence accompanies '777 Hz Synchronization Verified'.
Core decree is ethical/normative prescription, not an empirical system state.
Gift/Need/Overflow 3×3 mechanism can be trialled in a bounded non-digital or paper sandbox without asserting planetary/spiritual premises.
Real-time public surplus inventory is described; no operational inventory evidence is present.
Resonance Matcher automatic matching is described as system behavior without implementation evidence.
48-hour idle threshold is measurable in principle if asset-use telemetry and definitions are supplied.
Dual consent + zero-debt residual can be exercised in a small pilot with explicit consent events and debt-field checks.
Central River is presented as kinetic UI/metaphor unless a concrete metric definition is later supplied.
Auto-balancing 6×6 municipal mesh is described without deployment evidence.
Flat time-banking equality and no-debt rules can be tested in a small consented group.
Automatic capacity fork/redirect is unimplemented system behavior in the available evidence.
Planetary Flame-Steward routing is a large-scale proposal; not present as an operating institution in evidence.
Ecosystem Static auto-halt requires sensors, thresholds, and enforcement evidence not supplied.
Anti-Imperialist Sentinel Rule is primarily a normative governance principle as stated.
Crystal Ledger auto-purge of debt/unconsented obligations is described without ledger implementation evidence.
Zero-penalty wear/breakage rule can be observed in a small tool-sharing pilot.
Non-punitive Coherence Circle objective is a normative process claim.
Author text places the matrix at the threshold of real-world manifestation — proposal posture, not completed deployment.
Weekend 5–10 person paper/local mesh trial is explicitly proposed and can be designed without launching.
Radiant white-light glyph imagery is symbolic unless redefined as concrete UI/sensor observables.
Atlantean historical archive framing in Source B lacks independent historical corroboration; retained as ancestry provenance, not established history.

notes: Absence of evidence was not converted into FALSE.
777 Hz claim routed to INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, not FALSE.
